mechanisms: OSSL_CRMF_pbmp_new salt OwnedBuf and parameter construction
OSSL_CRMF_pbm_new OWF iteration loop and EVP_Q_mac tail
basekey cleansing on every success/failure arm
ERR_LIB_CRMF raise coordinates and ERR_add_error_data tail
file_dispositions.note: Line-for-line crmf_pbm.c:27-223. The salt block is a CRYPTO_malloc at :42 with its authority release coordinate, the MAC result at :137 with the :214 cleanup, and basekey is cleansed before every EVP_MD_free/EVP_MD_CTX_free arm. The null-argument set and the ASN1 OCTET/INTEGER and X509_ALGOR_set0 failure tails match. The size_t-to-int salt length and size_t-to-long iteration count conversions are the authority's own implicit conversions and are unchanged.

mechanisms: CTLOG_new_from_base64_ex key decode and CTLOG hand-off
file_dispositions.note: ct_b64.c:24-174. The decoder's output block is allocated for 3*(inlen/4), adopted as OwnedBuf, and either dropped on every refusal or into_raw'd only after the setter takes it. EVP_DecodeBlock guarantees a multiple-of-four non-empty group, so the padding walk cannot underflow; the three setter ownership arms match SCT_set0_log_id/SCT_set0_extensions/signature copy semantics. The key DER block is dropped after d2i_PUBKEY_ex, and the CTLOG failure arm frees the pkey reference.

mechanisms: CtxDestroy member body plus OB-3 zero-state sweep
file_dispositions.note: ct_policy.c:28-113. zalloc produces the all-zero context the CtxDestroy body is written for; propq is CRYPTO_strdup'd and released by OwnedBlock::take in the destructor. The gettimeofday/seconds2time/add/time2ms expression is the authority's wrapping/saturating arithmetic. setters keep the authority's X509_up_ref-then-store behavior.

ct_prn.c:132-240. Every ASN1_GENERALIZEDTIME_new has one free on every arm after the NULL guard; BIO_snprintf writes a bounded 20-byte scratch string; the stack walk uses sk_num per iteration exactly as the authority. Output fields and indent arithmetic match.

mechanisms: SctCtx repr(C) and CtxDestroy member body plus OB-3 zero-state sweep
file_dispositions.note: sct_ctx.c:23-274. certder/preder are owned from the encoder result and either installed into sctx or dropped on the authority's err order (cert DER, pre DER, duplicate); pretmp has a single X509_free. The authority's ct_public_key_hash error path that frees a reused *hash block (its md == *hash alias is freed unconditionally) is reproduced as documented at module lines 383-388 and site line 469; it is a retained, pre-existing compatibility obligation, not a new assumption. No in-crate caller can reach it: both callers pass a fresh context whose hash slot is NULL, and the functions are pub(crate) unsafe.

mechanisms: Sct repr(C) and CtxDestroy member body plus OB-3 zero-state sweep
set0/set1 member setters and their incumbent release
accessors, completeness predicates and source mapping
file_dispositions.note: ct_sct.c:22-385. set0 releases the incumbent through the seam before storing the adopter's block; set1 clears and re-duplicates exactly as the authority; set-version/entry-type/signature nid re-raise the same coordinates. SCT_validate creates one SCT_CTX, builds at most two X509_PUBKEY wrappers, and releases both wrappers and the context on every exit (including the UNVERIFIED early break).

mechanisms: SCT_CTX_verify length/hash/time checks and EVP context lifetime
five locally declared CT raise coordinates
file_dispositions.note: ct_vfy.c:29-137. tmpbuf is 12 bytes and the writes are exactly 1+1+8+2; the later l2n3/s2n reuse is 3/2 bytes. SCT_is_complete gates the log-id and signature reads before memcmp; the pkey presence test precedes pkeyhash use. EVP_MD_CTX_new has one free on each init/update/verify arm. The log-id comparison is the authority's public-data memcmp, not a secret comparison.

mechanisms: x509/ocsp d2i_SCT_LIST wrappers and source tagging
ossl_v3_ct_scts three-row table with ABI-compatible callback casts
file_dispositions.note: ct_x509v3.c:16-104. The decoder result has one SCT_LIST_free on the source-tag failure arm and the caller's *a slot is cleared; the success result is returned unowned by this frame, matching the ext_free row. The four const-fn transmutes reconnect typed callbacks to the table's void-based signatures with identical pointer-size ABI, the established v3-table pattern. No ownership crosses the table.

new_unsafe_assumptions.note: No source change. Every remaining unsafe operation in the eight files has an existing explicit SAFETY contract. The ct_sct_ctx ct_public_key_hash reused-buffer error arm is a documented retained authority-parity obligation, not a hidden one. The crmf size_t->int/long conversions are the authority's implicit conversions.
